result.one_liner: Coda (now rebranded Superhuman Docs) is a doc/table hybrid productivity platform with a REST API for docs, tables, rows, and formulas.

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
40+ endpoints across categories including Folders, Docs, Pages, Tables, Rows, Formulas, Controls, and Analytics
Coda MCP is now available in public beta! Official connectors with OpenAI and Anthropic have already been launched.

result.notes: Coda was acquired into the Superhuman product suite and is being rebranded "Superhuman Docs" (docs now live at docs.superhuman.com, coda.io/developers redirects there). The REST API uses a Bearer API token generated from account settings (self-serve, free tier included); createDoc requires Doc Maker/Admin workspace role but token generation itself is not gated. Could not directly verify OAuth2 support or the precise token-generation page (404s), and the OAuth discovery doc URL from precomputed context (coda.io/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server) was not independently confirmed — auth_methods may be incomplete if OAuth2 is also offered for third-party integrations. Official MCP server is in public beta with Anthropic/OpenAI connectors.
